requirements.title: Start charging at a chosen connector
requirements.actor: MobilePay customer with a saved payment card
requirements.intended_use: Start a charging session at the connector they chose.
requirements.description: A customer at a station picks a free connector and starts charging; the app refuses when no valid card is saved.

criteria.given: a free connector and a saved card
criteria.then: the session starts and the app polls its state every 5 seconds

requirements.title: Authorize the card before a session starts
requirements.description: The start handler refuses a request whose card authorization is not approved and sends nothing to the charge point.

criteria.statement: A declined authorization returns 402 and no start command is sent.

requirements.title: See receipts

requirements.description: Stations are listed and edited.

requirements.title: Register a card
requirements.description: A customer saves a card to pay with it later.

requirements.title: Rate a wash

requirements.title: Store the rating
requirements.description: The rating is stored against the wash session.

requirements.description: The service returns the requested data to the app.

requirements.description: The service returns the requested data to the app.
